source.title: Bayern Munich vs Barcelona | 8-2 | extended highlights and Goals | UCL 2019/20
source.authorization: Uploader is not the rights holder; authorization unknown; research/learning copy only; do not publish. Broadcast graphics and a small uploader watermark are present. English commentary is on the track (ASR 需复核).
source.clip_note: Re-encoded CRF18 cut of source 50.0-92.0s for transfer (<100MiB). Use full file on the user PC as the master research copy. Clip time = source time - 50.

timeline_source_s.50-54: pre-kickoff close-ups (Messi #10, Lewandowski face). Not the attack.
timeline_source_s.56-58: wide kickoff / opening midfield. White #14 (Perisic) readable around (1020,640). This is NOT continuous with the 3:02 box; there is an edit jump. Do not draw a pass/run from this shot into the goal sequence.
timeline_source_s.59.0-61.5: LIVE first-goal box combination and finish. Clock 3:02-3:04, BAR 0-0 BAY. Attack to the LEFT. Continuous same camera.
timeline_source_s.61.5-71: celebration and sideline reaction (white #6 Thiago readable in one cele frame).
timeline_source_s.72-74: REPLAY A high-wide, attack LEFT: Perisic #14 carries on the near/left flank into the box; ball then appears near the D.
timeline_source_s.75-77.5: REPLAY B behind-goal (attack toward BOTTOM of frame): #9 Lewandowski and #21 De Jong visible; loose/second ball in the box; shot toward goal.
timeline_source_s.78-80: Müller celebration close-up, clock 3:15, BAR 0-1 BAY. Shirt 25 only partially visible; identity from face + scoreboard, not a fully clear 25.
timeline_source_s.81-86: REPLAY C another wide angle of the same finish (do not mix with the later Alaba own-goal, which starts after ~104s / clip 54s — not in this cut).

Shirt 25 is only suspected on t074 and partially visible on t078, not a clean number lock on the shooting frame. On the shooting frames label him as white finisher, not a hard-locked #25.

A complete one-two with numbered Müller/Lewandowski on the live shooting frames (numbers are not readable there; #9 is locked only on replay B).
